prompt: Create an original 150 second instrumental post-rock instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: clean electric guitars, electric bass, live drums. Style: delay guitar figures and patient layered crescendos. Tempo approximately 92 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A dynamic and energetic instrumental track featuring a prominent electric guitar melody, supported by a driving rhythm section of bass and drums. The arrangement builds with layered guitars, including a lead guitar solo, and subtle synth pads, creating an uplifting and powerful sound.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和动感的纯音乐曲目，以突出的电吉他旋律为主，并由贝斯和鼓组成的强劲节奏部分支撑。编曲通过分层吉他（包括主音吉他独奏）和微妙的合成器铺垫逐渐增强，营造出一种振奋人心且充满力量的声音。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
